title: Fama–French Factor Attribution — alpha vs. hidden beta
method: OLS of daily book returns on tradeable ETF-proxy factors (MKT=VTI, SMB=IJR−IVV, HML=IVE−IVW, MOM=MTUM−VTI), 1-yr rolling overlay. Run on the book's multi-year backtest curve.
note: Only the flagship Trend+Carry book is attributed here (its sleeves Blend/Trend/Carry + an SPY β≈1 sanity check). The other live strategies will gain factor attribution once their multi-year backtest curves are added to the book-curves seed.
